title: Relative Time Intervals Representation for Word-level Timestamping with Masked Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.24041v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Although Speech Large Language Models (SpeechLLMs) excel at speech understanding and generation, their capacity for fine-grained, temporally aligned outputs remains underexplored. Our work addresses this gap by enabling SpeechLLMs to jointly model speech content and temporal structure, effectively transforming them from ``content understanding machines" into ``temporal-aware content understanding machines". Specifically, we replace traditional absolute timestamps with relative timestamps, achieving a more compact vocabulary and stronger generalization capabilities. To efficiently infuse timestamp prediction ability into pre-trained large language models, we introduce a hybrid fine-tuning strategy: full-parameter fine-tuning of the timestamp-augmented embedding layer and language model head, combined with LoRA fine-tuning of the decoder layers. translated_title: 基于掩码训练的单词级时间戳相对时间间隔表示
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24041v1 公告类型：新 摘要：尽管语音大语言模型（SpeechLLMs）在语音理解和生成方面表现出色，但它们在细粒度、时间对齐输出方面的能力仍未被充分探索。我们的工作通过使语音大语言模型能够联合建模语音内容和时间结构，有效将其从“内容理解机器”转变为“具有时间感知的内容理解机器”，填补了这一空白。具体而言，我们用相对时间戳替代传统的绝对时间戳，从而实现了更紧凑的词汇表和更强的泛化能力。为了高效地将时间戳预测能力注入预训练的大语言模型中，我们引入了一种混合微调策略：对时间戳增强的嵌入层和语言模型头进行全参数微调，同时对解码器层进行LoRA微调。此外，我们设计了一种掩码时间戳训练目标，以防止模型过度依赖——（注：原文摘要在此处截断，但根据上下文，该目标旨在防止模型过度依赖绝对时间信息，从而提升泛化性）。
tldr: 本文提出用相对时间戳表示和掩码训练目标，结合混合微调策略，使语音大语言模型具备单词级时间戳预测能力，将其升级为时间感知的内容理解模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces relative timestamp representation and a masked training objective, combined with a hybrid fine-tuning strategy, to enable SpeechLLMs with word-level timestamp prediction, transforming them into temporally-aware content understanding machines.
